sentences.en: How do you remove red wine stains from your carpet?
sentences.zh: 如何去除地毯上的红酒污渍？

sentences.en: The money got stained after the cash dispenser was forced.
sentences.zh: 那笔钱被弄脏了，因为自动取款机出了故障。

sentences.en: The stained glass painted colorful pictures on the church floor.
sentences.zh: 彩色玻璃窗在教堂地板上绘出了五彩斑斓的图案。
